# Jaroslav Kazejev

> Software engineer in Stockholm, Sweden, moving into AI engineering. Builds
> LLM agents, bots and the MCP tooling that agents use. Physics background
> from KTH.

## MCP server

This site publishes a read-only Model Context Protocol server. It holds the
same profile information as this file, in a queryable form.

- Endpoint: https://mcp.kazejev.com/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP, POST
- Protocol: MCP 2026-07-28; earlier revisions through the initialize handshake
- Server card: https://kazejev.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

Tools it provides:

- get_profile_summary — the whole profile in one response
- query_profile — takes a topic and returns the matching projects, skills and
  education
- get_bio, list_skills, list_projects, get_contact_info — the individual parts
